verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧੀਂ ਮਨੇ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਵੈ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਏ ਲੇਵੈ ਬਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sidhee(n) mane beechaariaa kivai dharasan e levai baalaa|

en.bdb: The siddhs thought in their mind that this body should in all circumstances Adopt philosophy of yoga.

verses.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਲੀ ਮਹਿ ਹਮਰੇ ਪੰਥੁ ਕਰੇ ਉਜਿਆਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: aaisaa jogee kalee meh hamare pa(n)th kare ujiaalaa|

en.bdb: Such a yogi in kaliyug, will brighten the name of our sect.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਪਰੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਨਾਥ ਜੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਭਰਿ ਲੈਵਣਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: khapar dhitaa naath jee paanee bhar laivan uTh chaalaa|

en.bdb: One of the Naths, gave him a begging bowl to fetch water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਇਆ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਡਿਠੇ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਲਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: baabaa aaiaa paaneeaai ddiThe ratan javaahar laalaa|

en.bdb: When Baba came to the stream for water, he saw rubies and jewels in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕੇਹੜਾ ਝਲੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਝਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur agam agaadh purakh kehaRaa jhale guroo dhee jhaalaa|

en.bdb: This true Guru (Nanak) was unfathomable supreme purusa and who could  bear with his effulgence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਥ ਜੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਠਉੜ ਨਹੀ ਉਸਿ ਤਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: fir aaiaa gur naath jee paanee ThauR nahee us taalaa|

en.bdb: He (remaining uninfluenced) returned to the  group and said, O Nath, in that stream there is no water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਜਿਤੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਕੀਤੋਸੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh jitee sidh ma(n)ddalee keetos apanaa pa(n)th niraalaa|

en.bdb: Through (the power of the word) Shabad he conquered the siddhs and propounded his altogether new way of life.
In Kaliyug, instead of yogic exercises the name of the Lord who is beyond all sufferings (Nanak) is the only source of delight.
